connector.name: Weapp Agent MCP
connector.registryDescription: Agent-first MCP server for WeChat Mini Program debugging & automation via WeChat DevTools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package weapp-agent-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chaixueyuan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WEAPP_WS_ENDPOINT
env.description: Automation WebSocket endpoint for the 'connect' flow (e.g. ws://localhost:9420). When a local endpoint is not listening and auto-launch is enabled, mp_ensureConnection may start DevTools if it can resolve a project.

env.name: WEAPP_AUTOMATOR_MODE
env.description: Force 'launch' or 'connect' mode. Defaults to 'launch' unless WEAPP_WS_ENDPOINT is set.

env.name: WEAPP_PROJECT_PATH
env.description: Optional Mini Program project directory used by launch and local auto-launch flows. The server can also resolve a persisted default, a recent project, or the current working directory.

env.name: WECHAT_DEVTOOLS_CLI_PATH
env.description: Optional override for the WeChat DevTools CLI binary path (e.g. /Applications/wechatwebdevtools.app/Contents/MacOS/cli on macOS).

env.name: WEAPP_DEVTOOLS_PORT
env.description: Automation websocket port passed to 'cli auto --auto-port' in launch mode (default 9420).

env.name: WEAPP_DEVTOOLS_TIMEOUT
env.description: Milliseconds passed to miniprogram-automator when launching WeChat DevTools.

env.name: WEAPP_AUTO_ACCOUNT
env.description: Optional account passed to miniprogram-automator launch.

env.name: WEAPP_TRUST_PROJECT
env.description: Whether launch mode should trust the project. Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, or on/off.

env.name: WEAPP_DEVTOOLS_ARGS
env.description: Additional whitespace-separated CLI arguments passed during launch.

env.name: WEAPP_DEVTOOLS_CWD
env.description: Optional working directory passed to the DevTools launch process.

env.name: WEAPP_AUTOCLOSE
env.description: Whether to close or disconnect the automator session after each tool call. Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, or on/off.

env.name: WEAPP_AUTOLAUNCH
env.description: Allow mp_ensureConnection to launch local WeChat DevTools with cli auto when the configured local automation port is not listening. Defaults to enabled; set false to disable.

env.name: WEAPP_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT
env.description: Milliseconds to wait for a locally auto-launched automation port (default 45000).

env.name: WEAPP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Milliseconds to wait for an automator websocket connection (default 45000).
